minimumLaterMatrix.requirementOrigin: Each of the six authored NPC records declares minimum idle/talk and eight directions
minimumLaterMatrix.timingStatus: Choose after neutral identity review and actual pose production; not a gameplay balance decision

optionalLaterMatrix.requirementOrigin: Authored animation.secondary specifies one profession/prop gesture in a later pack; qi/VFX separate from body

artContract.largerMotionCanvas: May add padding only; preserve human world scale and explicitly measured world foot
artContract.nativeReview: Direct comparison to same-direction live Wang at native1x and integer2x; standing height80 alone does not establish matching anatomy
artContract.neutralOrNewViewInputPolicy: Image1 actual live Wang of the same direction is PRIMARY anatomy/camera/pixel/style. Own approved or selected NPC identity can support identity/costume; no NPC-to-NPC style chain.
artContract.actionIdentityPolicy: Lock the NPC's own skull, face, hair, body, clothing and prop identity across poses. Compare directly with same-direction live Wang at native1x.
artContract.sameViewActionCorrectionPolicy: An explicitly documented action-only correction may put the existing same-NPC/same-direction source at Image1 as edit target and Wang same-direction at Image2 as PRIMARY anatomy/style. Pin the target hash and prove its original Wang-first provenance; preserve neutral intent.
artContract.bodyFxShadow: Keep body, profession prop production decisions, qi/FX and shadow explicitly separated; never bake qi, forge flame or sword trail into body
artContract.rootMeasurement: Measure boot/support foot as world root, not the lowest spear/sword/prop pixel or bounding-box center

actors.name: Bạch Chỉ
actors.authoredLook: Nữ khoảng ba mươi; áo lá trà/ngà, tay áo buộc gọn, giỏ dược và chày ngọc.
actors.authoredPersonality: Mềm lời nhưng không dễ tin; kể chuyện qua mùi và vết cắt lá.
actors.authoredBrief: Silhouette giỏ dược, bàn tay chày; palette lá ấm khác áo ngọc của giảng sư.
actors.authoredSideStory: Cùng một luống dược, hai vết hái: quan sát trước khi kết tội người hái.
